a9f0bb34731c80aa.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each circuit. Referenced by races.circuitId to link races to their venue.

ebb1355ff44d1d7c.column_purpose: Unique short slug/code identifying each circuit (e.g. 'ricard', 'zolder', 'interlagos'), used as a stable textual reference key.

540476c4fa9abbf8.column_purpose: Country where the circuit is located (e.g. France, USA, UK).

6a413877c66913d0.column_purpose: Latitude of the circuit's geographic location in decimal degrees (range -34.9 to 57.3, consistent with worldwide circuit locations).

fc78f920697f905a.column_purpose: Longitude of the circuit's geographic location in decimal degrees (range -118.2 to 138.9, consistent with worldwide circuit locations).

d8a44f7bc79f280b.column_purpose: Town, city or locality where the circuit is situated (e.g. Le Castellet, Heusden-Zolder, Silverstone).

bbca4dedd0ad580d.column_purpose: Full official name of the circuit (e.g. 'Circuit Paul Ricard', 'Silverstone Circuit').

fea5b122045a4fe4.column_purpose: Wikipedia URL for the circuit's article; one unique URL per circuit.

d2a77cf8c41c7312.column_purpose: Identifier of the constructor (team) that scored the points; references constructors.constructorId.

c1068702031750ec.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for the constructor-per-race points record.

bfbfec72f2113551.column_purpose: Championship points scored by the constructor in that race (0–66; larger values reflect combined points of both cars and, in some eras, different points systems).

ce0d0f873777c606.column_purpose: Identifier of the race in which the points were scored; references races.raceId.

55b607427a48277e.column_purpose: Almost always null; the only observed value is 'D', which likely marks a disqualified constructor result. The exact code meaning is not confirmed by other evidence.

95fa09143ffa72c7.column_purpose: Identifier of the constructor (team); references constructors.constructorId.

b3caf729d04be988.column_purpose: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each standings row.

e440cb5c2b083d66.column_purpose: Cumulative championship points accumulated by the constructor up to and including that race (max 765, half points like 27.5 reflect shortened-race point splits).

e85863ff265c1c3b.column_purpose: Constructor's championship standing position (rank) after that race, 1 = leading the championship.

c333cb90c639a7e5.column_purpose: Position rendered as text; in this dataset it always equals the numeric position (in other F1 datasets it can hold 'E' for excluded, but no such values appear here).

450b406d56a14a6c.column_purpose: Identifier of the race after which the standings were computed; references races.raceId.

51ee2b64462acd28.column_purpose: Cumulative number of race wins by the constructor up to and including that race.

f017f6cceb5cd767.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each constructor. Referenced by results, constructorResults, constructorStandings and qualifying.

71a749da4e154e4b.column_purpose: Unique short slug/code identifying the constructor (e.g. 'tyrrell', 'zakspeed'), likely used as a stable external reference key.

cfe942e8d17f8e06.column_purpose: Full display name of the constructor/team (e.g. 'Alfa Romeo', 'Brabham-Repco').

fe84f5f6287a36f7.column_purpose: Country/nationality of the constructor (e.g. British, American, Italian).

3d8b1647b7afd32f.column_purpose: Wikipedia URL for the constructor's page. Not unique because some constructors (e.g. Cooper variants) share the same Wikipedia article.

4046b3e51bed8631.column_purpose: Identifier of the driver this standing belongs to; references drivers.driverId.

527d12608a980af6.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each standings row.

5258a8bafe51e16a.column_purpose: Cumulative championship points the driver had accumulated in the season up to and including this race (max 397, half points like 27.5 occur due to shared points or shortened races).

579582b8654dabb7.column_purpose: Driver's championship standing position (rank) after the given race; 1 = championship leader.

7370659c2f844723.column_purpose: Text representation of the championship position; in this dataset it duplicates the numeric position (values like 'D' for disqualified may exist elsewhere but are not observed here).

ee304e55ad948a9b.column_purpose: Identifier of the race after which this standings snapshot applies; references races.raceId.

1ab092434189b0b7.column_purpose: Number of race wins the driver had accumulated in the season up to and including this race.

bbe2c348521939b1.column_purpose: Three-letter driver abbreviation (e.g. VER, ROS, SAI) used in timing screens and TV graphics. Mostly null because permanent codes were only introduced in recent seasons.

84a984e32f044e11.column_purpose: Driver's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Range 1896-1998 covers the full history of the sport.

fa0cdb81f7b1576c.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each driver, referenced by results, driverStandings, pitStops, lapTimes and qualifying.

b97b5e1fdb89c2c4.column_purpose: Unique human-readable slug (typically surname-based, e.g. 'gilles_villeneuve') used as a stable reference key in the Ergast-style API.

5d90d5d67ac89777.column_purpose: Driver's nationality as an adjective (British, American, Italian, ...), 41 distinct values including hyphenated dual nationalities.

1202c2864f454871.column_purpose: Driver's permanent race number (2-99) introduced in 2014; null for drivers who raced before permanent numbering.

0129dd4f433d9e37.column_purpose: Link to the driver's Wikipedia page; unique per driver.

00a6c6d626034571.column_purpose: Identifier of the driver who recorded the lap; references drivers.driverId (many-to-one).

460846f71da867e5.column_purpose: Lap number within the race, starting at 1 (max observed 78, e.g. number of laps completed so far). Part of the row's composite key with raceId and driverId.

352adb563eb2b4ff.column_purpose: Lap time in milliseconds (e.g. 91255 ms = 1:31.255, matching the time column).

d4309d0c360bf612.column_purpose: The driver's race position (1–24) at the end of that lap; roughly equal counts per position reflect one driver per position per lap.

328c4ef9aeb4836c.column_purpose: Identifier of the race; references races.raceId (many-to-one).

87a3f8cc9c6a4c8a.column_purpose: Lap time formatted as m:ss.mmm (e.g. '1:31.255'), the human-readable form of milliseconds.

e70847c3069fff62.column_purpose: Identifier of the driver making the pit stop; references drivers.driverId (many-to-one).

b5477be9c4130eb8.column_purpose: Pit stop duration in seconds, stored as text with millisecond precision (e.g. '24.719' = 24.719 s); string form of milliseconds.

752cf14283fe4572.column_purpose: Lap number of the race on which the pit stop occurred (1–74).

ce697a221c1fcb26.column_purpose: Pit stop duration in milliseconds (e.g. 30888 ms = 30.888 s); numeric counterpart of duration. Max ~2011 s likely reflects an anomalous/very long stop.

5639ceacabcfd04f.column_purpose: Identifier of the race in which the pit stop occurred; references races.raceId (many-to-one).

38f6193a83b4e214.column_purpose: Sequential pit stop number for that driver within the race (1st stop, 2nd stop, etc.; 1–6).

95ce885d1bcf4565.column_purpose: Local time of day (HH:MM:SS) at which the pit stop occurred.

30bc3bcc0dd2b202.column_purpose: Foreign key to constructors.constructorId; the team the driver was driving for in this qualifying session.

2f58ef0243df83a7.column_purpose: Foreign key to drivers.driverId; the driver who took part in this qualifying session.

16bc74470f3f5257.column_purpose: The driver's car/race number used in that session (0-99, e.g. 7, 18).

de2736536ece0316.column_purpose: Final qualifying position (grid slot) achieved by the driver in that race's qualifying, 1 = pole sitter; up to 28.

15053a67d425381c.column_purpose: Driver's best lap time in the Q1 qualifying segment, formatted as m:ss.mmm. Null/empty if the driver set no Q1 time.

b1e3e79c9713a568.column_purpose: Driver's best lap time in the Q2 qualifying segment (m:ss.mmm). Null for drivers eliminated after Q1 (~51.5% null rate).

b401d78a6366244c.column_purpose: Driver's best lap time in the Q3 qualifying segment (m:ss.mmm). Null for drivers eliminated after Q1/Q2 (~71% null rate).

bdff752c5329da09.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each qualifying result row.

40376a39f5b6f7c7.column_purpose: Foreign key to races.raceId; the race (round) this qualifying session belongs to.

8e076f8ce8d00876.column_purpose: Foreign key to circuits.circuitId, the venue where the race was held.

e78aa0458d03cabb.column_purpose: Date the race took place (1950-05-13 to 2017-11-26).

99356649774095ec.column_purpose: Name of the Grand Prix, e.g. 'British Grand Prix', 'Italian Grand Prix'.

588fa3947d3bcbec.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the race, referenced by results, qualifying, lapTimes, pitStops, driverStandings, constructorStandings, constructorResults.

15e5ad0b0cd3485e.column_purpose: Round number of the race within its championship season (1–21).

9580e1bed5fcf1ab.column_purpose: Scheduled local start time of the race in HH:MM:SS format; null for 75% of rows (mostly older races where start time is unknown).

6346dc2138c91465.column_purpose: Wikipedia article URL for the specific race edition (e.g. 1950_Belgian_Grand_Prix).

dd35aa32e0413df8.column_purpose: Championship season year the race belongs to (1950–2017).

32151a5321b8e449.column_purpose: Identifier of the constructor (team) the driver raced for; references constructors.constructorId.

473cbf316d334c11.column_purpose: Identifier of the driver; references drivers.driverId.

1b3b8fadc485bebf.column_purpose: Lap number on which the driver's fastest lap of the race was set (2-78). Null for races before this data was recorded (~2004) or when not applicable.

43494b1ecfc37b57.column_purpose: Average speed of the driver's fastest lap, in km/h (range ~89.5-257.3). Stored as VARCHAR.

d81fd724e7edf291.column_purpose: Time of the driver's fastest lap, formatted m:ss.mmm (e.g. 1:21.134).

808e2bdad5e3e258.column_purpose: Starting grid position of the driver (1 = pole). 0 indicates starting from the pit lane or no recorded grid position.

0ae1313046ec6924.column_purpose: Number of laps completed by the driver in the race; 0 for drivers who did not start.

c96e8a19290f75ee.column_purpose: Total race time for classified finishers, in milliseconds (e.g. 6076447 ≈ 1h41m). Null for non-finishers.

a423dc8c8f17eb8f.column_purpose: Car/driver number used in that race (0-208).

b092809cec170f89.column_purpose: Championship points scored by the driver for this race result (0-50; fractional values reflect shared points or fastest-lap rules).

efd6eabffc7fca4c.column_purpose: Official finishing position (1 = winner) for classified finishers; null for non-classified results (DNF, DSQ, etc.).

da74c7bf19b82554.column_purpose: Finishing order of all entries in the race, always populated (1 = first); unlike 'position', it ranks non-finishers too.

6f81221dcfc76ebe.column_purpose: Finishing position as text: a number for classified finishers, or a code such as 'R' (retired) and 'F' for non-finishers.

20fda41b8a23e293.column_purpose: Identifier of the race (Grand Prix); references races.raceId.

327a4f06c1470055.column_purpose: Rank of the driver's fastest lap within the race (1 = fastest lap of the race, up to 24). Null when fastest-lap data is absent.

4184f97d5e310d13.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the race-result row.

6fe362643359b7f6.column_purpose: Identifier of the finishing status (e.g. finished, retired, accident); references status.statusId.

3d8f5605f416ae2a.column_purpose: Gap to the race winner as text, e.g. '+24.160' (seconds) or '+8:22.19' (minutes:seconds); null for the winner and non-finishers.

6fdac74b4b5c38f3.column_purpose: URL of the Wikipedia article for that season's Formula One championship (e.g. http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1950_Formula_One_season). One unique URL per season.

7bb0abf8d9b924df.column_purpose: Calendar year of the Formula One championship season. Unique, one row per year, ranging 1950-2017 (68 seasons). Likely the table's primary key despite not being flagged.

6d039f4b1b595135.column_purpose: Human-readable race status: either a finishing classification relative to the winner ('+N Laps') or the reason a driver did not finish (e.g. 'Engine', 'Out of fuel', 'Fuel rig', 'Water pipe', 'Exhaust').

1280b2dfdd7137ac.column_purpose: Primary key of the status lookup table; surrogate integer identifier for each distinct status label. Referenced by results.statusId to classify each race result.
